sources.entry: Slash - An open source, self-hosted bookmarks and link sharing platform. GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Slash is an open source, self-hosted platform for creating, organizing, and sharing short `s/` links and bookmarks, with tags and optional public or team sharing.
summary.what_it_does: Slash lets you create customizable, human-readable short links (shortcuts like s/shortcut) that point to any URL. Links can be categorized with tags and shared either publicly or only with teammates. The README says it provides analytics on link traffic and sources. Shortcuts can be grouped into Collections that can be shared with anyone on any browser. A browser extension lets you use your shortcuts from the browser search bar to jump to the corresponding URL, with installers linked for Chromium-based browsers and Firefox.
use_cases: Create short memorable links for long URLs
Share useful links with a team
Track click traffic and sources for links
Jump to URLs from the browser search bar
Publish a public collection of links
notable: Creates s/ shortcuts that expand to any URL
Browser extension for using shortcuts from the search bar
Collections can be shared publicly with anyone
caveats: The README does not describe the underlying implementation languages or the full list of dependencies
Browser extension installation depends on the Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons listings
Setup details are deferred to external docs not included in the README
